## Où j'en suis
Maya built an SRE take-home exercise for a candidate: docker compose stack (flaky-svc, Prometheus, Alertmanager, loadgen) with three planted problems (renamed metric in the alert rule, connection leak, over-broad IAM policy), 3-hour time box, no Kubernetes. It lives in the private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home`, pushed via subtree split (last commit `1f6c0b4`), and `hiring/` was removed from the `maya/sre-take-home` infra branch working tree.

- [en-cours] `hiring/` deletion on the infra branch is not committed; Maya will drop the branch anyway
- [prochaine-étape] After Thursday's call, Maya sends the exercise herself and adds the candidate as collaborator
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch build with `--load` fails (manifest lists unsupported); amd64-only image gave exec format error on Apple Silicon — solved by building flaky-svc from source in compose (commit `5ac0d91`)
- [décision] No Kubernetes, 3 hours max, Terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] Compose builds flaky-svc from source, no prebuilt image (source: t06)
- [décision] Rubric scores 0–3 per area with no pass threshold; panel (Maya + Noa) decides (source: t10)
- [décision] Exercise in its own private repo, not infra (source: t12)
- [décision] No PRs in infra, no emails sent by the agent (source: t14, t16)
